example.criterion: After a correction, invite a retry OR ask a follow-up, not both. A correction or translation is not itself an inquiry. A hint is not itself a follow-up question. One invitation to try after a correction or hint is allowed. Count actual directed inquiries, not questions quoted as language examples. Fail on two independent requested learner responses; pass with at most one.
